Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1368
Claimant:
Frank Chan
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-04-03
Claim opened after a low-speed head-on collision reported by the claimant, who was driving the insured vehicle at the
time. The claimant reports a wrist injury and states they are not represented by an attorney.
2024-04-24
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. Scheduled a call to take a
full statement and request the claimant's mediacl records.
2024-05-30
Claimant gave a statement today and described the impact the same way as on first notice of loss. No new details
have emerged, and the account has stayed consistent across every conversation so far.
2024-06-10
Photos from the scene and the repair estimate show damage that lines up with the described impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main evidence of how the collision happened.
2024-06-26
Confirmed with the policyholder that the claimant lives in the household and is a listed driver under the policy, so
coverage applies to the claimant as a household member. Checked the policy effective history and found nothing
indicating the vehicle damage perdates the coverage start.
2024-07-05
Requested prior vehicle records and inspected the repair file. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and
nothing in the file suggests a prior loss.
2024-07-17
Medical records received show a wrist fracture treated with a longer course of care than is typical for this injury.
Requested additional treatment notes to understand the timeline of care.
2024-09-02
Searcehd available records and asked the claimant about prior problems. No earlier injury to the same area of the
body is known, but the claimant's prior history is still being confirmed with the provider.
2024-09-04
The medical file does not yet establish whether the fracture was caused by this collision. Referred the file to the
medical review team for an opinion on causation and the link between the crash and the injury.
2024-10-19
Status remains open pending the medical review and the remaining treatment records. Will follow up with the
claimant once the causation opinion is back to discuss next steps.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
